Convert RGB values to a HEX color

Source: R/rgb2hex.R
rgb2hex.Rd

Converts red, green, and blue (RGB) color values into a six-digit hex triplet.

Usage

rgb2hex(r, g, b)

Arguments

r

a numeric for red channel intensity, between 0 and 255.

g

a numeric for green channel intensity, between 0 and 255.

b

a numeric for blue channel intensity, between 0 and 255.

Value

A character string containing a six-digit hex triplet in the format #RRGGBB.

Details

RGB values are specified using the 8-bit RGB color model, in which each channel ranges from 0 (no intensity) to 255 (maximum intensity). Values must be whole numbers, although they may be supplied as either integers or numeric values.

Examples

rgb2hex(0, 47, 95)
#> [1] "#002F5F"
rgb2hex(196, 232, 237)
#> [1] "#C4E8ED"
rgb2hex(255, 255, 255)
#> [1] "#FFFFFF"
